request.style: English, male baritone, solo, harmonica, slide guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, mournful and steady, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tamar bore Perez and Zerah
Judah had five sons in all
Sons of Perez are Hezron
And Hamul stands beside him tall

[Chorus]
From Perez to Hezron
Hezron to Ram
Ram to Amminadab
The name remains

[Verse]
Amminadab father of Nahshon
Nahshon father of Salmon
A link in the line of Judah
A name in the ancient scroll

[Chorus]
From Perez to Hezron
Hezron to Ram
Ram to Amminadab
The name remains

[Bridge]
Jesse and Obed and Boaz
Salah and Nahshon
Amminadab and Admin
Arni and Hezron

[Chorus]
From Perez to Hezron
Hezron to Ram
Ram to Amminadab
The name remains

[Outro]
Son of Perez
Son of Judah
The line is clear
